milestones.title: P0 Foundations
milestones.description:
Goal: a proven toolchain, a tested data core, and an app shell running as a packaged build on both phones. Soft marker: early November 2026.

Exit criteria:
1. Packaged builds from the pinned Flet run on the owner's Android phone and iPhone with no laptop connection. Offline first launch shows the bundled schedule on the Schedule stub (days, session counts, source); online, a refresh replaces it. State survives kill and relaunch, and an update install.
2. CI is green on main. The feed tests (rules, invariants, snapshot) pass on the 2025 and 2026 feeds.
3. The shell passes the S4 navigation journey on both phones with stub detail screens. The shell smoke flow (flet test) passes on an emulator and a simulator.
4. Spikes S1-S5 are closed with verdicts in docs/spikes/, and their outcomes are recorded in docs/decisions.md (Flet pin mechanics, list-row architecture, route shape, performance targets).

milestones.title: P1 Attendee core
milestones.description:
Goal: the attendee core is good enough to demo and to use for a whole simulated conference day. Soft markers: demo slice end of November 2026; exit mid-December.

Exit criteria:
1. On both phones, packaged builds in airplane mode: open on Now; session -> speaker -> session -> Back; star and unstar with Undo; My schedule shows overlaps; search finds sessions, speakers and rooms on any day; filters stay visible and persist.
2. A simulated conference day (fake clock, 2026 feed): Now respects end times and shows your next session; Jump to now works; nothing scrolls unasked (#313); Back pops one step (#279).
3. A failed refresh (offline, HTTP error, corrupt payload) keeps the last good data. Time-zone and id tests pass under two machine time zones.
4. TalkBack and VoiceOver complete search -> favourite -> session detail. Text at 200 % clips no action; contrast tests are green.
5. Performance against D-80 is measured and recorded; no known crashes.
6. A 2-3 minute recording of the demo slice exists.

milestones.title: P2 Conference companion
milestones.description:
Goal: everything an attendee needs at the venue, offline, plus reminders. Soft marker: February 2027.

Exit criteria:
1. Every P2 row of docs/feature-matrix.md is done, or re-dispositioned with a reason.
2. In airplane mode: floor plans with room pins, the expo map and list, Wi-Fi, Help & safety and venue hours work from bundled year data; the loader test is green.
3. Reminders: with E3 pinned, a saved session's reminder fires with the app killed and after an Android reboot, the tap opens the session, and the reminder moves with the session. Without E3 the interim says so. A denied permission never blocks a task.
4. The change log shows a simulated change from a fixture feed pair, saved sessions first. Deep links and reminder taps land with a back stack.
5. The device checklist passes (D-79), including high contrast, tablet layout and screen readers on three new flows.
6. Someone other than the owner installs an internal build and, unaided, finds a room, saves a session and copies the Wi-Fi password.

milestones.title: P3 Accounts & staff tools
milestones.description:
Goal: the private-API features, built faithfully against the local mock, with the scanner as the showcase. Soft marker: March 2027.

Exit criteria:
1. Every tool kept under O-7 completes scripted scenarios against the mock on both phones, with manual and HID entry, and with the camera when E1 is bundled (otherwise the scan screen shows the interim).
2. The offline queue: airplane-mode scans survive kill and restart; under idempotent mock semantics each record syncs exactly once, and under non-idempotent semantics no record is lost and a duplicate occurs only after a lost response, where it is detected and shown (D-57); failures are visible with Retry; sign-out with unsynced rows asks first.
3. Fault-injection scenarios and the Ionic-derived signing vectors pass. A wrong role cannot reach a tool (truth table).
4. A test proves the client refuses PSF hosts.
5. If E1 is bundled, a printed sheet of mock badges scans on both phones, including two devices checking in the same attendee; otherwise the same scenario passes with manual or HID entry.

milestones.title: P4 Showcase
milestones.description:
Goal: polish, publish, present. Soft marker: ready in April 2027, before PyCon US (May 12-18).

Exit criteria:
1. No known data-loss or task-blocking bugs; performance targets met on our devices.
2. Someone else, or the owner on a clean machine, builds and runs the app from a clean checkout in 30 minutes or less, following docs/development.md.
3. The demo script runs end to end twice without Wi-Fi.
4. The repo is public, and v1.0.0 is tagged with internal builds for both platforms.
